items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: But now when I was with Ben, he brought in Eddie Nicholson from Tulsa and -- who plays a straight, swinging drum, you know, and we had one of the best rhythm sections down on 52nd Street.

ctx.x: Eddie Nicholson. And, you know, he later got involved in that stuff with Billie Holiday.
